claude-team-api-credit.formula: min(500, 20*standardSeats+100*premiumSeats) at grant; no assumed seat count

conditions: Claim and Console organization association required; no automatic entitlement.
Credits expire and are shared by the linked organization; not OAuth subscription quota.
Actual remaining balance and expiration must be supplied explicitly.
No rollover, no enforced spending cap, no implicit permission for overage.
Team offers depend on seat composition; not inferred from Max benefits.
Seven days on an active eligible plan and appropriate organization/plan roles are required; not verified by the compiler.
Only one linked organization/plan; credits refresh on billing-cycle dates, not assumed calendar-month dates.
Provider auto-reload/purchased balances can continue usage; this program never enables them.
